item.name: Aerial Assault
item.effect: Improves floater success when a guard or wing gets into the paint without relying on dunks.
item.cardSummary: Aerial Assault helps layup-focused players turn paint touches into more reliable floaters.

item.name: Alley-Oop Finisher
item.effect: Boosts lob finishes from teammates and also helps self-lob attempts near the rim.
item.cardSummary: Alley-Oop Finisher is for players who score from lob catches, rolls, cuts, or self-lobs.

item.name: Gymnast
item.effect: Boosts difficult layup gathers such as spins, half-spins, hop steps, euro steps, cradles, reverses, and change-shot finishes.
item.cardSummary: Gymnast supports guards and wings who finish with advanced layup gathers instead of straight-line attempts.

item.name: High Flyer
item.effect: Extends the distance from which driving dunks can trigger, making rim attacks start from farther out.
item.cardSummary: High Flyer is a core dunking badge for slashers, forwards, and bigs that attack open lanes.

item.name: Paint King
item.effect: Helps bigs create space inside by pushing defenders during hop steps or post moves near the basket.
item.cardSummary: Paint King gives interior players a better chance to make room before finishing at the rim.

item.name: Relentless Finisher
item.effect: Keeps contact layup and dunk attempts viable when defenders meet the scorer near the rim.
item.cardSummary: Relentless Finisher is for bigs and slashers who expect body contact on layups or dunks.

item.name: Traffic Finisher
item.effect: Improves close-range finishes through contact, especially contested dunks around the rim.
item.cardSummary: Traffic Finisher helps athletic forwards convert drives when help defense is already waiting.

item.name: Corner Spot Up
item.effect: Boosts catch-and-shoot attempts from the corner for off-ball players spacing the floor.
item.cardSummary: Corner Spot Up gives forwards a clearer shooting role when they wait in the corner instead of posting up.

item.name: Deep Post Fade
item.effect: Improves post fade attempts taken farther from the basket, giving post scorers a mid-post counter.
item.cardSummary: Deep Post Fade is a shooting option for bigs and power forwards who work from the mid-post.

item.name: Formless Shooter
item.effect: Boosts difficult off-dribble jumpers such as hop steps, spins, stepbacks, and pull-ups.
item.cardSummary: Formless Shooter supports shot creators who take jumpers after movement instead of only standing still.

item.name: Limitless Shooter
item.effect: Extends the effective range for standing three-point shots when the shooter gets set.
item.cardSummary: Limitless Shooter lets perimeter builds threaten from deeper range on set three-point attempts.

item.name: Mid-Range Maestro
item.effect: Raises mid-range shot reliability, especially for players who use pull-ups and shots inside the arc.
item.cardSummary: Mid-Range Maestro rewards builds that use middies as a main scoring answer when threes or drives are covered.

item.name: Quick Draw
item.effect: Speeds up catch-and-shoot jumpers so defenders have less time to close out.
item.cardSummary: Quick Draw is valuable for shooters who receive passes and need to fire before the contest arrives.

item.name: Tunnel Vision
item.effect: Reduces the shot penalty from defenders closing out on mid-range and three-point attempts.
item.cardSummary: Tunnel Vision helps jump shooters stay reliable when a defender recovers late to contest.

item.name: Dimer
item.effect: Boosts teammates' shot chances after they receive a pass from the badge holder.
item.cardSummary: Dimer turns good kick-outs and setup passes into more valuable scoring chances for teammates.

item.name: Glove
item.effect: Makes the ball harder to strip when defenders reach against the dribbler.
item.cardSummary: Glove protects high-usage guards from losing the ball to aggressive reach attempts.

item.name: Post Hook
item.effect: Improves post hook attempts near the basket when a defender takes away a fade or direct finish.
item.cardSummary: Post Hook gives frontcourt players a close-range scoring counter from the block.

item.name: Quick Handles
item.effect: Improves the ability to chain dribble moves together quickly.
item.cardSummary: Quick Handles helps creators move from one dribble move into the next without feeling delayed.

item.name: Quick Pass
item.effect: Speeds up pass release and pass velocity, helping the ball move before defenders rotate.
item.cardSummary: Quick Pass is useful for guards, forwards, and bigs who need to move the ball out of pressure.

item.name: Spacemaker
item.effect: Helps create separation on space-making moves such as stepbacks, side steps, and similar shot-creation actions.
item.cardSummary: Spacemaker is a shot-creation badge for ball handlers who use movement to create a clean look.

item.name: Tireless Handles
item.effect: Reduces the stamina lost from dribble moves, allowing longer chains before tiring out.
item.cardSummary: Tireless Handles lets dribble-heavy players keep creating without draining energy as quickly.

item.name: Intimidator
item.effect: Strengthens contests so nearby offensive players miss more often when tightly guarded.
item.cardSummary: Intimidator is a defensive badge for players who stay close enough to make every shot attempt uncomfortable.

item.name: Locks
item.effect: Improves perimeter cutoffs, hip riding, and the ability to stay in front of ball handlers.
item.cardSummary: Locks helps perimeter defenders stop blow-bys and stay attached during drives.

item.name: Lurker
item.effect: Improves chase-down block ability for defenders who recover from behind or from the side.
item.attributeNote: A center guide recommends Gold or higher before it starts feeling reliable.
item.cardSummary: Lurker gives rim protectors more value when they rotate late but still have a block angle.

item.name: Navigator
item.effect: Helps defenders work through screens without getting stuck on the screener.
item.cardSummary: Navigator is for guards who need to stay connected to shooters and ball handlers through picks.

item.name: Post Lockdown
item.effect: Makes it harder for post scorers to back down, move, or create space against the defender.
item.cardSummary: Post Lockdown is a frontcourt defense badge for holding position against post scorers.

item.name: Rebound Chaser
item.effect: Helps players track down missed shots faster on both offensive and defensive rebounds.
item.attributeNote: One 6'9 build guide ties Bronze Rebound Chaser to 59 Rebound.
item.cardSummary: Rebound Chaser is the main badge for ending possessions or creating second chances on the glass.

item.name: Rim Saver
item.effect: Widens effective shot-blocking range near the basket, helping block attempts that would otherwise get over the defender.
item.attributeNote: One 6'9 build guide ties Gold Rim Saver to 80 Interior Defense and 85 Block.
item.cardSummary: Rim Saver is a core paint-defense badge for bigs and switchable forwards.

item.name: Thief
item.effect: Improves the chance of creating steals when the ball handler exposes the ball.
item.attributeNote: A point guard guide cites 84 Steal for consistent Thief results.
item.cardSummary: Thief is for defensive guards who want to pressure the ball and create extra possessions.

item.name: Tough Ankles
item.effect: Lowers the chance of getting crossed over or ankle-broken by opposing dribble moves.
item.cardSummary: Tough Ankles helps perimeter defenders survive change-of-direction moves without losing balance.

item.name: Trampoline
item.effect: Boosts repeated jumps for blocks and contests, helping interior defenders keep challenging shots.
item.cardSummary: Trampoline supports power forwards who stay near the rim and need multiple jumps in one possession.
